description: This Kotlin source file defines the LeavesAdapter class, which is an adapter for displaying a list of leave items in a RecyclerView in an Android application. It manages the creation and binding of view holders for each leave item, rendering leave title, date, and type.

classes.name: LeavesAdapter
classes.description: Adapter class extending RecyclerView.Adapter to display a list of Leave objects in a RecyclerView.

classes.name: LeaveViewHolder
classes.description: ViewHolder class holding references to the views for each leave item (title, date, type).

methods.name: onCreateViewHolder
methods.description: Creates a new ViewHolder by inflating the item_leave layout.

methods.name: onBindViewHolder
methods.description: Binds data from a Leave object to the ViewHolder's views, formatting the date appropriately.

methods.name: getItemCount
methods.description: Returns the total number of leave items.

methods.name: updateLeaves
methods.description: Updates the adapter's leaves list with new data and refreshes the RecyclerView.
